items.question: What is TranTradingLab?
items.answer: TranTradingLab is a risk-first market analysis platform. We provide daily insights, weekly switchboard signals, and public Bold Calls with full accountability. All content is free.

items.question: Is there a subscription fee?
items.answer: No, all content on TranTradingLab is completely free — Dashboard, Blog, Learn hub, Bold Calls, and Newsletter.

items.question: What information is available on the Telegram channel?
items.answer: We send core market briefings every morning. These include major index trends, important economic indicators, and trading ideas.

items.question: What is the Weekly Switchboard?
items.answer: The Switchboard is our weekly signal board covering 8 key assets (SPX, BTC, Gold, 10Y, DXY, Oil, VIX, KOSPI). Each asset gets a risk-on, risk-off, or neutral signal. Published every Monday.

items.question: What are Bold Calls?
items.answer: Bold Calls are public, time-bound market predictions with clear invalidation criteria. We track every call publicly — wins and losses — for full transparency.

items.question: How often is content updated?
items.answer: Blog posts 2-3 times per week. Switchboard every Monday. Bold Calls as they arise. Dashboard data refreshes throughout the day.

items.question: When is the Switchboard updated?
items.answer: Every Monday morning. Each of the 8 assets (SPX, BTC, Gold, 10Y, DXY, Oil, VIX, KOSPI) receives a fresh Risk-On, Risk-Off, or Neutral signal for the week ahead.

items.question: Which markets do you cover?
items.answer: We cover US equities (S&P 500), crypto (BTC/ETH), commodities (Gold, Oil), macro (DXY, 10Y Yield, VIX), and Asian markets (KOSPI). All analysis is bilingual — English and Korean.

items.question: Is this suitable for beginners?
items.answer: Absolutely. Our content is designed from zero to advanced. Start with the Learning Hub and Glossary, then follow the weekly Switchboard and Daily Briefings as you build confidence.
